# @dxtmisha/configuration

> Shared Vite and TypeScript configuration presets for building UI components, libraries, and applications in DXT UI.

Provides centralized and standardized Vite configs, Rollup plugins, and TypeScript presets to eliminate boilerplate across packages.

## Vite Presets

- [viteBasic](viteconfig/viteBasic.config.js): Default Vite configuration preset for standard libraries.
- [viteBasicFunction](viteconfig/viteBasicFunction.config.js): Parameterized Vite config factory for functional utilities, composables, and classes.
- [viteComponents](viteconfig/viteComponents.config.js): Vite configuration for component libraries with module preservation, MDX support, and style injection.
- [viteConstructors](viteconfig/viteConstructors.config.js): Vite config for constructor packages aggregating library entries and MDX support.
- [viteFigma](viteconfig/viteFigma.config.js): Specialized config factory for Figma plugin bundles (sandbox code + iframe UI).
- [viteFlags](viteconfig/viteFlags.config.js): Optimized build config preset for SVG flag and geographic asset packages.
- [viteLibrariesRollup](viteconfig/viteLibrariesRollup.config.js): Multi-entry aggregate library configuration with bundled TypeScript declarations.
- [viteMdx](viteconfig/viteMdx.config.js): Vite configuration with MDX documentation support.
- [vitePurgeCss](viteconfig/vitePurgeCss.config.js): Vite configuration extending viteBasicFunction with PurgeCSS for unused CSS elimination.

## Rollup & Vite Plugins

- [vitePluginComponents](functions/vitePluginComponents.js): Post-build Vite plugin injecting component styles (`styleToken.css`) into output chunks.
- [vitePluginLibrary](functions/vitePluginLibrary.js): Post-build Vite plugin injecting library CSS imports (`style.css`) into entry bundles.
- [vitePluginPurgeCss](functions/vitePluginPurgeCss.js): Post-build Vite plugin for removing unused CSS selectors using PurgeCSS.

## TypeScript Presets

- [tsconfig.app.json](tsconfig/tsconfig.app.json): Base TypeScript configuration preset for browser application and library client code.
- [tsconfig.node.json](tsconfig/tsconfig.node.json): Base TypeScript configuration preset for Node.js build scripts and tooling.
